mods.name: Seal doors
mods.blurb: Flood barriers and seals on doors and low vents keep shallow water out.

mods.name: Elevate the house
mods.blurb: Lift the floor above likely flood levels. Expensive, but very effective.

mods.name: Foundation improvement
mods.blurb: Strengthen and waterproof the foundations so floodwater does less harm.

mods.name: Drainage
mods.blurb: Better drains and soak pits carry surface water away from the house.

mods.name: Sandbags at house
mods.blurb: A wall of sandbags at the doors. Used up when a flood hits.

mods.name: Store food
mods.blurb: An emergency pantry lets you stay home safely and skip buying emergency supplies, which cuts recovery costs. It doesn't protect the building. Used up when a disaster hits.

mods.name: Retaining wall
mods.blurb: An engineered wall holds back the bank behind the house.

mods.name: Soil nailing
mods.blurb: Steel bars drilled into the slope pin loose soil in place.

mods.name: Planting trees
mods.blurb: Deep roots bind the soil, and growing trees take in carbon.

mods.name: Drainage over loose soil
mods.blurb: Drains on the slope stop rain soaking in and loosening the ground.
